evidence.quoted_text: exec(compile(data, str(path), "exec"), module.__dict__)  # noqa: S102 - bound bytes
evidence.reason: At the current tip, `_load_helper` catches read failures and hash mismatches as `Refused`, but the `compile`/`exec` call is unguarded. A readable helper with invalid Python syntax raises `SyntaxError` from line 82 before the controller lock, bypassing the refusal/error path. In `--json` mode that violates current contract item 2: machine mode keeps stderr empty and emits an `{ error: … }` object on stdout when there is no result. The smallest compatible fix is to catch compile (and execution) failures at this helper-load boundary and raise `Refused`, while preserving the one-read hash check and executing only the hashed bytes.
